propositions: rebar transition --class not_a_bug without --reason and no replacement link currently routes to completion verifier, which incorrectly synthesizes and fails a criterion about fixing a nonexistent defect
not_a_bug should be added to REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES so that --reason (RCA summary) is mandatory at write time, and a live replacement link can optionally satisfy it instead
A deterministic disposition attestation (class + reason) must be minted and signed without LLM invocation when not_a_bug close is authorized via reason or replacement

escalated disposition has the same structural problem (no in-repo work completed) and must be reason-required with identical logic: live replacement checked first, --reason as fallback, neither present -> refusal
Write-side validation must refuse not_a_bug and escalated closes without a replacement link or --reason, naming both available doors; fall-through to completion verifier is eliminated
